question_text: During the election period, a government employee, Mr. Santos, is asked by his superior to attend a political rally for a candidate. Mr. Santos is unsure if this is allowed. Under the norm of 'political neutrality' in RA 6713, which of the following is correct?

options.text: Mr. Santos may attend the rally as long as he does not wear his official uniform or use government property.
Mr. Santos may attend the rally because it is his right as a citizen to participate in political activities.
Mr. Santos should not attend the rally because public officials must remain neutral and cannot engage in partisan political activities.
Mr. Santos may attend the rally if he files a leave of absence for that day.
